items._tools: Tools are held in the weapon hand (equip slot weapon): pick one on the hotbar and it replaces the sword. Held, a hatchet chops wood at yield x the base rate and a pick breaks stone, ore and sulfur at its own; anything else gathers at the base rate. tool: kind, yield, damage (a light hit as a weapon, heavy x1.6), head (its colour on the hand model, linear RGB). They wear with every hit (gather.tools in tuning.json); at 0 they stop giving their yield until repaired at a workbench.

items._fishing: Fishing (WRFishing.cpp, Data/fish.json): a fishing rod held in the weapon hand casts (hold the attack, let go), strikes and reels. Bait in the bag (cut bait, or a lure for the biome) brings bites sooner and is taken by the fish at the bite; lures (Bait maker perk) also draw rare fish. Fish are food, eaten raw or grilled at the workbench; the big ones are a heavy haul.

items._ranged: Ranged slot (G swaps it with the sword, right mouse aims, left mouse fires). ranged: kind, ammo kind it fires (none = thrown itself), damage (+ the ammo's), speed cm/s, gravity scale, reload s, torpor x the ammo's; mesh / socket / along / face / meshAlong / meshFace / rot / offset place it in the hand: socket is the hero's hand socket (weapon_r, bow_l: the palm's frame), along / face are forward / up / out / back / fingers / grip (through the fist) / palm / backhand / arm (down the forearm) / hands (level, toward the other hand), measured in the body clip named by pose (none = the reference pose); offset is cm in the socket's frame.
